subject: pathology
title: Myocarditis, cardiomyopathies and pericardial disease

steps.tx: **Myocarditis** (viral Coxsackie B commonest, parvovirus B19, Chagas with apical aneurysm, diphtheria, hypersensitivity drugs, **giant cell** fulminant in young with VT) presents with chest pain, heart failure or arrhythmia after viral prodrome; troponin with MRI Lake Louise criteria supports while **Dallas criteria** (endomyocardial biopsy lymphocytic infiltrate with myocyte necrosis) confirms. Most viral cases rest into recovery with heart failure therapy; giant cell needs combined immunosuppression with transplant listing, fulminant cases need mechanical support. Athletes rest months.
steps.say: Chest pain with failure after viral flu is myocarditis: rest, biopsy Dallas confirms. Giant cell VT storms need transplant listing.

steps.tx: **Dilated cardiomyopathy** (alcohol, peripartum, haemochromatosis, anthracyclines, TTN truncations, tachycardia induced) dilates thin walls into systolic failure treated as HFrEF with devices; **hypertrophic cardiomyopathy** (autosomal dominant **MYH7 and MYBPC3**, **asymmetric septal hypertrophy** with SAM and dynamic outflow murmur easing on squatting, myocyte disarray) kills young athletes suddenly. HCM management is beta blockers, **septal myectomy or alcohol ablation** for obstruction, ICD by risk (family death, unexplained syncope, massive thickness, NSVT), endocarditis prophylaxis debated, strenuous sport avoided.
steps.say: Thin dilated failure is DCM. Thick septum with dynamic murmur is HCM: beta block, myectomy, ICD by risk.

steps.tx: **Restrictive cardiomyopathy** (amyloid with low voltage plus thick walls, sarcoid with AV block, haemochromatosis, endomyocardial fibrosis) stiffens diastolic filling with **Kussmaul sign** (JVP rising on inspiration) shared with constriction; **arrhythmogenic RV cardiomyopathy** (**plakoglobin desmosomes**, epsilon waves with T inversions V1 to V3, VT of LBBB morphology, fibrofatty replacement) restricts athletes with ICD. **Stress Takotsubo** (postmenopausal grief, apical ballooning with clean coronaries) recovers; **LV noncompaction** trabeculates with clots and failure.
steps.say: Thick walls with tiny voltage are amyloid restrictive. Epsilon waves with LBBB VT are ARVC: ICD, no sport.

steps.tx: **Acute pericarditis** (viral idiopathic, uremic, post MI Dressler, TB, purulent Staph) gives pleuritic pain easing leaning forward with **diffuse concave ST elevation and PR depression**; treatment is **NSAIDs plus colchicine** (aspirin post MI), steroids only in autoimmune or refractory. **Tamponade** (Beck triad hypotension with muffled sounds and JVD, **pulsus paradoxus**, electrical alternans, diastolic chamber collapse) needs urgent **pericardiocentesis**; **constriction** (calcified rigid sac, **pericardial knock**, equalised diastolic pressures, septal bounce) needs **pericardiectomy**.
steps.say: Lean forward relief with diffuse ST elevation is pericarditis: NSAID plus colchicine. Muffled shock with paradoxus is tamponade: needle now.
